record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare BLAZE_KICK: Blaziken (3 stars), Combusken (2 stars), Torchic (1 star). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count, range and maxPP. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Burns the cast target for a base 2000 ms, deals SPECIAL damage (raw 30/60/120/240 by stars, x1.3 if the target was already burning before the cast), then knocks the target to the farthest empty cell along the board line from the caster in the target's direction. If no empty cell lies on that line, the target stays.

targeting.note: effectInOrientation walks all cells in the target's 8-way direction from the caster to the board edge (including empty cells before the target) and the last empty cell visited is chosen. The direction is sign-based (dx, dy), not an exact line to the target, so a target at a non-diagonal offset is pushed along the nearest of the 8 directions that matches the signs of its offset, which may not pass through its own cell.

geometry.shape: displacement along one of 8 board directions to the farthest empty cell; no area damage

declaredRaw.label: requested damage (raw), before the burning-target bonus

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]; if the target was burning when the cast started, requested = Math.round(requested x 1.3). handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The burn is applied before the damage, so the burn bonus tests the state before this cast.

declaredRaw.description: moveTo(farthest empty cell along the target's 8-way direction from the caster), forcedDisplacement true

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: nothing happens if no empty cell was found, or if moveTo refuses (the target, or the unit on the destination, cannot be moved). Otherwise the cells are swapped, the target goes to the moving state and its cooldown is set to 100. The displacement happens even if the damage was blocked by protect / magicBounce (it is not conditioned on the damage result).

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the target lacks IMMUNITY_BURN, rune protect and the WATER_BUBBLE passive; applied duration = requested after the target's duration reductions; replaces the running burn timer only if longer. While burning the target takes TRUE damage of 5% max HP each second (reduced by weather, Assault Vest, water effects; zero with Well Baked or Magmarizer).

starBehavior.note: Damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (240, also the ?? fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. Burn duration and displacement do not depend on stars. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The knock-back destination depends on the caster's and target's coordinates and on which cells in that direction are empty; with no empty cell there is no movement.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. A second cast on a target that is still burning gets the x1.3 damage bonus; the burn timer is only extended if the new 2000 ms exceeds the remaining time.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 30/60/120 (1/2/3 stars), x1.3 rounded if already burning; burn 2000 ms. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied burn duration = requested after the target's reductions.
